member.name: T:NLogLayout
member.summary: Represents a parsed NLog layout, which is a string template used to format log messages.
member.remarks: An NLog layout consists of a combination of literal text and variables (e.g., ${level}, ${message}) that are replaced with dynamic values at runtime. This class parses the layout string into tokens, allowing for structured processing of the layout.

member.name: M:NLogLayout.#ctor(System.String)
member.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class with the specified layout line.
member.param: The raw layout string to be parsed and used for formatting log messages. Cannot be null or empty.

member.name: T:LayoutToken
member.summary: Represents a token in a layout, including its type, name, raw value, and position within the layout.
member.remarks: This class is used to encapsulate information about a specific token in a layout. The token can represent various types, such as variables, and provides details such as its raw representation and its position within the layout string.

member.name: P:LayoutToken.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of the token.

member.name: P:LayoutToken.Name
member.summary: Gets or sets the name associated with the variable.

member.name: P:LayoutToken.Raw
member.summary: Gets or sets the raw string representation of the data.

member.name: T:TokenType
member.summary: Represents the type of a token in a parsing or evaluation context.
member.remarks: This enumeration is typically used to distinguish between tokens that represent literal values and those that represent variables or placeholders.
